applies_why: The judge text addresses Matthew 1:16 and expressly says the defender and challenger answered it, so the rule about not counting an answered verse governs.
quote: the defender answered the beget-pattern and naming witnesses in [CR3] LINK 4 and [CR2] §5, and the challenger answered hēs in [DR3] C2.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: The judge says Matthew 1:16 was answered by both sides and does not count it as an unanswered witness.
